shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin rebounded to $64,000-$65,000, recovering from June losses amid renewed ETF inflows.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index remains at 23, signaling 'Extreme Fear' among investors despite recent price increases.
The SEC's 2026 regulatory agenda indicates intent to clarify digital asset frameworks, potentially reducing enforcement risks.
Stablecoin issuer Circle gained final OCC approval to establish a national trust bank, bolstering stablecoin legitimacy.
Federal Reserve Chair comments on lower inflation risks helped fuel Bitcoin's recovery, with the upcoming July 28-29 Fed meeting being a key event.
